meta.title: sitemap.pi
meta.description: A directory to discover and promote .pi sites built on Pi Network

home.title: sitemap.pi
home.description: Discover .pi sites built on Pi Network in one place. Listing is free and published after review.

bubble.canvasLabel: Site bubbles — size shows the plan (ad/own), color shows the view change. Tab to move, Enter to open
bubble.sampleToast: This is a sample site — a fictional example with no detail page.
bubble.sampleNote: Includes samples — bubbles tagged "Sample" are fictional example sites.
bubble.demo: Demo data (includes samples) — the database is not connected, so only the listed sites and fictional samples are shown; changes for listed sites are 0%.

auth.required: Please sign in with your Pi account.
auth.openInPiBrowser: Open this page in Pi Browser to sign in with your Pi account.

detail.leaveTitle: You are leaving for an external .pi site
detail.leaveBody: You are leaving sitemap.pi for the site below. Its content and payments are the responsibility of its operator.

report.title: Report site
report.done: Your report was received and will be reviewed.

me.title: My sites
me.empty: You have not listed any sites.
me.withdrawConfirm: Withdraw the listing for {domain}? It will be removed from the directory.
me.verifyGuide: Domain ownership check: publish only the value below at {url} on your site. An admin checks it during review.

form.reReviewNote: Editing a listed site sends it back to review; it is hidden until approved again.
form.piBrandWarn: Domains starting with 'pi' may be rejected under the Pi trademark policy.
form.name: Site name
form.imageHint: PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF up to 2MB. Images are reviewed too.
form.pvtHint: Used only for review questions, never shown publicly. Required to submit.
form.pvtRequired: A review contact is required to submit.
form.pubHint: Shown on the site page if provided.

admin.title: Admin
admin.memoPlaceholder: Reason or note (optional, shown to the owner)
admin.verifyStep1: Open this address in Pi Browser and confirm it matches the token exactly
admin.verifyStep2: If it differs or does not open, reject with reason "Domain ownership not verified" — the same owner cannot resubmit this domain
admin.verifyStep3: Confirm the site content matches the listing and the prohibited-category rules
admin.ownershipVerified: I confirmed the ownership file matches the token
